verdict.rationale: Docs mention Exa returns 'extracts of only the relevant tokens from a webpage' via a specialized extraction model, which goes beyond simple snippets but is described as token-efficient partial content rather than full page text or markdown output. There is no explicit documentation in the pack of a dedicated full-text or markdown retrieval mode/parameter. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a 'text'/'markdown' content field or contents API returning complete page text, independent confirmation that full-page markdown is retrievable rather than just relevant excerpts.
